input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position in full. 21.1 sets a single mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000, and expressly states the cap is mutual. 21.2 excludes indirect/incidental/special/punitive/consequential damages and lost profits mutually ("neither Party is liable"), and helpfully confirms data-restoration, replacement-service, notice and incident-response costs are direct damages. 21.3 defines Excluded Claims (sitting outside both the cap and the damages exclusion) to cover breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not damages and is not limited by the Section. The "Fees" definition (1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap basis is meaningful rather than illusory (it excludes a one-time implementation charge, a minor point mitigated by the USD 1,000,000 floor). Section 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities and 19.5 preserves indemnity, confidentiality and data-protection duties from any disclaimer. No one-sided or sub-cap language appears elsewhere. No redline required.
